title: CD-SEM Measurement - Edge Placement Error Detection on WaferSight PWG
subtitle: Post-Metallization Quality Validation for 5nm Node Manufacturing
author: Dr. Priya Sharma

sections.1_OBJECTIVE:
This test case validates the capability of the WaferSight PWG system to detect and classify Edge Placement Error defects during post-metallization inspection at the 5nm technology node. The test is conducted at Chandler Fab 42 to ensure manufacturing quality standards are met for 450mm wafer production.

The primary objective is to verify that the inspection system meets the required detection sensitivity and classification accuracy for Edge Placement Error defects that are critical to yield at the 5nm node. This test case is part of the ongoing qualification program for the WaferSight PWG platform.
sections.2_SCOPE:
- Product Line: WaferSight PWG
- Inspection Type: CD-SEM Measurement
- Target Defect: Edge Placement Error
- Process Step: Post-Metallization
- Wafer Size: 450mm
- Technology Node: 5nm
- Fab Location: Chandler Fab 42

This test case applies to all WaferSight PWG systems deployed at Chandler Fab 42 for post-metallization monitoring in the 5nm manufacturing line. Results from this test are used to establish baseline performance metrics and to qualify new recipe configurations.
sections.3_TEST_CONFIGURATION:
System: WaferSight PWG
Software Version: v14.0.557
Recipe: CD-SEM_MEASUREMENT_5nm_POST_METALLIZATION
Illumination Mode: Darkfield
Scan Speed: High (166 mm/s)
Pixel Size: 0.25μm
Edge Exclusion: 4mm
Sampling Plan: 21-point sampling
sections.4_TEST_PROCEDURE:
1. Power on the WaferSight PWG system and allow 30-minute warm-up period.
2. Load the calibration wafer and run the standard calibration routine.
3. Verify calibration results are within specification (±2% tolerance).
4. Load the test wafer onto the stage using the automated handler.
5. Select the 'CD-SEM Measurement' recipe from the recipe library.
6. Configure detection sensitivity to target Edge Placement Error defects.
7. Set scan parameters: full wafer scan with edge exclusion of 3mm.
8. Initiate the inspection run and monitor real-time defect map.
9. Upon completion, review the defect density map and classification results.
10. Export results to the factory automation system (SECS/GEM interface).
11. Compare results against the golden reference baseline.
12. Document any anomalies and generate the summary report.
sections.5_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA:
- Defect detection sensitivity must meet 5nm node requirements
- False positive rate shall not exceed 5% of total detected events
- Scan throughput must be ≥ 110 wafers per hour
- Classification accuracy shall be ≥ 90% for known defect types
- Repeatability (3-sigma) shall be within ±1.5% for CD-SEM Measurement
- System uptime during test shall be ≥ 98%
- All results must be traceable through the MES integration
- Measurement correlation with reference tool shall be ≥ 0.97 R²
sections.6_TEST_RESULTS:
Test Execution Date: 2024-05-01
Wafers Tested: 37
Total Defects Found: 3409
Defect Density: 1085.12 defects/cm²
Nuisance Rate: 2.4%
Capture Rate: 86.2%
Test Duration: 201 minutes
System Uptime: 99.3%

Result Classification: PASS
sections.7_OBSERVATIONS:
a) The WaferSight PWG demonstrated excellent performance in detecting Edge Placement Error at the 5nm node.

b) The capture rate requires optimization of the detection algorithm.

c) Nuisance rate is within acceptable limits.

d) Cross-correlation with the reference SEM confirmed classification accuracy.

e) SECS/GEM communication was verified with zero packet loss during data transfer.
sections.8_CORRECTIVE_ACTIONS: No corrective actions required. Test passed all acceptance criteria.
